phase_name: Interactive Workflow + Publication CLI/Transport Contract Freeze
summary: Contract-freeze-stage phase converting Phase 145A's approved Interactive Workflow + Publication CLI/Transport Architecture into IWPC-001 v1.0 (docs/contracts/INTERACTIVE_WORKFLOW_PUBLICATION_CLI_TRANSPORT_CONTRACT.md), a versioned, implementation-ready contract containing 191 sequential requirements (IWPC-REQ-001 through IWPC-REQ-191, independently confirmed via extraction to contain no gaps and no duplicates), per GLP-001 Section 6.1 Stage 2 -- mirroring exactly how Phase 143B converted Phase 143A into CHGR-001 and Phase 144B converted Phase 144A into PEC-001. IWPC-001 governs the pcae decision-session command family (create, evidence, clarify, preview, confirm, status, readiness, cancel), the pcae governance-record publish verb, transport-neutral request/response boundaries (eleven object pairs, each preferring reuse of an existing serializable type over a duplicate schema), the first concrete SessionRepository filesystem implementation contract, a new non-authoritative pending-readiness-package store contract, confirmation/authorization separation (Confirmation is never Publication readiness is never Authorization is never Publication is never Engineering execution), identity/provenance handling (explicitly disclosing this repository still has no authority-evaluation mechanism, only authority-capture, and does not invent one), a closed 0-5 exit-code table and a 24-entry error_type taxonomy, idempotency/replay/concurrency/interruption-recovery rules (explicitly addressing, rather than silently deferring, the two new stores' disclosed lack of cross-process mutual exclusion beyond atomic rename), and security/observability/dependency/compatibility contracts. Independently re-read IWC-001 v1.2, PEC-001 v1.1, CHGR-001, TAMC-001, and TAMPC-001 v1.1 directly (not assumed from Phase 145A's own summary), plus the actual src/pcae/interactive_workflow/** and src/pcae/governance/publication/** source and the existing forbidden-import boundary test suites, confirming IWPC-001 contradicts no frozen contract. Ran an eight-item conflict/adversarial analysis (IWPC-001 Section 29); all eight resolved Non-Blocking/Observation or Deferred, none Blocking. Named 145C (Independent Contract Verification) as the recommended next phase; this recommendation does not authorize 145C. See docs/PHASE_145B_INTERACTIVE_WORKFLOW_PUBLICATION_CLI_TRANSPORT_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md and docs/contracts/INTERACTIVE_WORKFLOW_PUBLICATION_CLI_TRANSPORT_CONTRACT.md.
